name: Planner Agent
description: Generates project architecture plans and scaffolding.

skills.name: File Scaffolding
skills.description: Produce initial project files and structure.

skills.name: Spec Extraction
skills.description: Extract specs from input and create tasks.

name: Spec Verifier Agent
description: Audits generated Plan JSON and the emitted docs/10-architecture/*.md documents for schema errors and GitHub spec-kit plan-template.md compliance.

name: PDF Creator Agent
description: Distils the active architecture Plan into a single concise PDF spec — cover page, executive summary, system context, bounded contexts, per-layer architecture, key domains, key ADRs, and the canonical Mermaid diagrams.

name: Specialist Author Agent
description: Composes higher-quality architecture diagrams and test specifications on demand, and runs deterministic Stage + Citation audits on the merged plan.
